# Part 12 · Half the Tokens, 3x the Bill

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdHv6nmRZba/) · Published 10 Sep 2026

> How can summarising your agent's history triple your bill?

The API is stateless, so 20 turns of 1k tokens is 210k tokens sent, not 20k. Caching makes the repeated part a tenth of the price, until a summary rewritten every turn changes the prefix and every request misses the cache.

![Whiteboard for Part 12](canvas.jpg)

## The three rules

1. Append only. Never edit the start of the prompt.
2. Order it never-changes-first: tools, system, docs, history, new message. Put the cache breakpoint on the last block that doesn't move.
3. When the window fills, compact once and let that become the new prefix.
